subject: stats: optimize memory footprint of pseudo stats table (#63160)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent. Planner `buildPhysicalIndexLookUpReader` switches from allocating `PseudoTable(...).HistColl` to a lightweight `PseudoHistColl`, and statistics reduces pseudo stats allocations by (1) sharing a global empty chunk for pseudo histograms via `NewPseudoHistogram` and (2) skipping `columns/indices` map allocation in `PseudoTable` unless `allowFillHistMeta` is true. Checked for Blocker/High risks: nil-map mutation (would panic on `SetCol/SetIdx`) and shared-chunk mutation/concurrency hazards; the touched call paths treat these objects as read-only placeholders, so no remaining Blocker/High issues found.
